holdout_context.rule: benchmark BTC daily close against its own 200-day EMA, with that EMA's 20-day change deciding trend from range: BULL when close > EMA200 and the EMA rose over the last 20 days, BEAR when close < EMA200 and it fell, SIDEWAYS otherwise, UNDEFINED while either input is still warming up. This is the project's existing convention (trading_bot/research/swing/backtest.py::build_regimes), reused rather than re-invented; it is a market label for reporting, never a signal.
holdout_context.warm_up: the frozen 1h shards continued with the holdout shards before aggregating

edge07_active_fade.why: the setup loses money before any fee on DEV (-0.788 USDT/trade over 255 trades), which no cost change can repair

edge07_active_thrust.why: the setup loses money before any fee on DEV (-0.2694 USDT/trade over 338 trades), which no cost change can repair

declared_cost_wall.note: a book at this frequency must earn more than the round-trip cost per trade, on average, before it earns anything

2X_FEES.by_regime_note: entry trend state of the candidate's own filter (the value that let the trade through), NOT a market regime; see by_market_context for the benchmark-relative one
2X_FEES.sharpe_convention: per-1h equity returns, annualised with 8760 bars/year; None when fewer than 100 observations
